import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/tmp/engine-prefix-scoring-20261104')
reference=Path('/tmp/engine-performance-20261104/reference')
common=['taskset','-c','2','npm','run','perf:engine','--','--mode=compile',f'--reference={reference}/scripts/lib/native_motion/engine.wasm',f'--reference-root={reference}','--confirm-rounds=24','--warmup=5','--reps=3','--margin-pct=2']
def measure(name,cell,*flags):
 subprocess.run(common+[f'--cells={cell}',f'--out={root}/{name}',*flags],cwd='/home/holo/line',check=True)
 return json.loads((root/name/'result.json').read_text())
def resources_pass(result):
 for case in result['resources']:
  a,b=[arm['resources'] for arm in case['arms']]
  if a['wasmLinearMemoryBytes']!=b['wasmLinearMemoryBytes'] or b['processMaxRssBytes']>1.15*a['processMaxRssBytes']:return False
 return True
screen=measure('screen',62,'--rounds=12','--seed=1729')
guard=measure('default-guard',61,'--rounds=12','--seed=1729')
qualified=screen['decision']['verdict']=='FASTER' and guard['decision']['intervalPct'][1]<=2 and resources_pass(screen) and resources_pass(guard)
if qualified:
 print('Screen and default/resource guards qualify; starting fresh 24-pair confirmation.',flush=True)
 confirm=measure('confirm',62,'--stage=confirm','--rounds=24','--seed=2718',f'--screen={root}/screen/result.json')
 print('Confirmation qualification:',confirm['performanceQualified'] and resources_pass(confirm),flush=True)
else:print('Screen/default/resource qualification failed; no confirmation or extra pairs.',flush=True)
